title: author.json — advisory author fingerprint
description: The advisory author fingerprint fetch detected in the bundle's PR text. It never blocks a review, never changes what is reviewed, and never pins a model; an unknown author writes no file at all rather than guessing, so absent means unknown, not human.

agent.description: The agent family the strongest signal names. A spoofable claim, recorded for routing and for the review/author pair trend groups, never a gate.

model.description: The model a Co-authored-by trailer names after the agent's own name, verbatim; null when the signal names none.

confidence.description: high means an explicit machine-written trailer or the 'Generated with Claude Code' line; medium means a naming convention (a [codex] title tag or a codex/ or cursor/ branch prefix). A contradiction in evidence leaves the strongest signal naming the agent.

evidence.description: Every signal that matched, in scan order (title, body, head ref, then each commit), so a reader can second-guess the verdict instead of trusting one string.

field.description: Where the signal was found: the PR title, its body, its head ref, or a commit message.

signal.description: The text that matched, exactly as the PR carried it.
